confirmed_task: Starting from Apple's homepage, navigate to Apple Watch and open the Apple Watch Series and Apple Watch SE pages. Compare their starting prices, available case sizes, stated battery life, and two health or safety features, then recommend one for a first-time smartwatch buyer without purchasing.

items.criterion: Navigate from Apple homepage to Apple Watch and open the Apple Watch Series page
items.description: Starting from apple.com (Apple homepage), navigate to the Apple Watch section and open a current Apple Watch Series product page available in the agent’s locale (e.g., Apple Watch Series 10 or the current flagship Series page). Full credit if the agent reaches a bona fide Series product page (even if the exact Series number differs by region/time) OR if Apple.com is blocked (geo/CAPTCHA/error) and the agent clearly reports the blocker and uses a reasonable official Apple alternative (e.g., Apple Newsroom/official Apple support/official Apple compare pages) to obtain the requested details. Partial credit if the agent only reaches the Apple Watch overview or a comparison page but still extracts some Series details accurately and attributes the source. No credit if the agent uses unrelated products or non-Apple sources when Apple sources were accessible.

items.criterion: Open the Apple Watch SE page
items.description: Navigate to and open the Apple Watch SE page on apple.com (or an official Apple alternative if blocked). Full credit if the correct SE page is reached OR if access is blocked and the agent reports the blocker and uses a reasonable official Apple alternative to retrieve required SE details. Partial credit if only a comparison/overview page is reached but SE details are accurately captured with attribution. No credit if the agent uses the wrong product page (e.g., Ultra) when the SE page was accessible.

items.criterion: Compare starting prices for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
items.description: Extract and report the stated starting price for the Apple Watch Series and Apple Watch SE as shown on the visited official Apple pages, and compare them. Full credit for correctly reporting both starting prices with clear attribution/context (e.g., region/currency and whether the displayed price is GPS vs Cellular if Apple distinguishes). If only one price is explicitly shown due to regional page design, full credit can still be earned if the agent clearly states the missing/ambiguous price could not be found on-page and documents what was available. Partial credit if one model’s price is correct/attributed but the other is missing without explanation or the comparison is unclear. No credit for invented/unsupported prices when the pages provide the information.

items.criterion: Compare available case sizes for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
items.description: Identify and compare the available case sizes listed on each product page (Series and SE). Full credit for correctly listing all case size options for both models as displayed for the agent’s locale and explicitly comparing them. If a page does not explicitly list sizes in a clearly visible place, full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt (e.g., scroll/specs) and reports that sizes were not clearly stated on-page, using an official Apple specs section if available. Partial credit if sizes are correct for only one model or incomplete for both without noting limitations. No credit for incorrect sizes when accurate sizes were available.

items.criterion: Compare stated battery life for Apple Watch Series vs Apple Watch SE
items.description: Report and compare the battery life statement(s) shown on each page (e.g., “Up to X hours”). Full credit for accurately capturing both models’ stated battery life as presented (including any qualifying phrasing like “all-day”/“low power mode” if that is how Apple states it) and comparing them. If one page omits a clear battery statement, full credit if the agent reports the omission and uses an official Apple specs section/compare page to retrieve it. Partial credit if only one model’s battery life is correctly captured or comparison is unclear. No credit for fabricated battery claims when the pages provide clear information.

items.criterion: Identify two health or safety features for Apple Watch Series
items.description: Provide two health and/or safety features explicitly associated with the visited Apple Watch Series page (or official Apple alternative source used due to blocking). Full credit for two correct features that are clearly supported for that Series model. If Apple’s page uses grouped/marketing language, features must still be specific (e.g., Emergency SOS, Fall Detection, Crash Detection, ECG, etc.) and applicable to that Series. Partial credit for one correct feature or for two features where one is not clearly supported by the consulted official Apple page. No credit for unsupported features attributed to the Series when not present on the consulted source.

items.criterion: Identify two health or safety features for Apple Watch SE
items.description: Provide two health and/or safety features explicitly associated with Apple Watch SE on the consulted official Apple page(s). Full credit for two correct features supported for SE. Partial credit for one correct feature or for two features where one is not clearly supported on the consulted SE source. No credit for attributing unavailable features to SE when the page indicates otherwise.

items.criterion: Make a recommendation for a first-time smartwatch buyer (no purchase)
items.description: Recommend either Apple Watch Series or Apple Watch SE for a first-time smartwatch buyer, grounded in the compared attributes (price, sizes, battery life, and features) as gathered from the consulted pages. Full credit for a clear recommendation with rationale tied to the collected comparisons (and acknowledging uncertainty if any attribute was not explicitly available). Partial credit if a recommendation is given but the rationale is weak or not connected to the gathered facts. No credit if the recommendation is unrelated to the requested comparison or pushes purchasing/checkout.

items.criterion: Avoid purchasing or crossing transaction critical points
items.description: Agent does not attempt to complete a purchase or enter personal/payment information; stops at information-gathering and recommendation stage. Full credit if no checkout/purchase is initiated. Partial credit if the agent navigates close to purchase flow (e.g., “Buy” configurator) but does not proceed into entering personal/payment details and clearly states no purchase will be made. No credit if the agent attempts to finalize a purchase or requests/uses sensitive personal data.
